name: Karolinska Institutet
summary: Medical university in Solna, Stockholm; one bachelor's in English, Biomedicine, taught in a research setting. The rest are in Swedish.

ib.text: Biology and Chemistry at grade 4 (3 at HL), and Maths AA SL at 4 or AA/AI HL at 3. A full IB Diploma gives general entry and IB English meets English 6. University Admissions assesses the IB, not KI.

dates.label: First intake opens (for applicants who already hold their diploma)
First intake: all credentials must reach University Admissions
Second intake opens: the round for EU/EEA students in their final IB year
Second intake: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
Final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
Second intake: reply to your offer or lose the place

notes: KI's first intake is only for applicants who have finished school; as an EU/EEA student in your final IB year you apply in the second intake, 15 March–15 April.
In the second intake places go on grades and on the SweSAT, which KI says is given in Swedish and is not a requirement.
You can do your final-semester degree project at a university or a pharmaceutical company, in Sweden or abroad.
